title: Cash Rate by Homeowner Tier, Optional Coverage Add-Ons Settlements
content:
The cash rate applied to a cash settlement under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons follows the tier of the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract:

| Base homeowner contract tier | Cash rate |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum | 1.00 (100 percent) |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Gold | 0.95 (95 percent) |
| Any other tier, or a base that is not a homeowner contract | 0.90 (90 percent) |

**Hypothetical cases.** A rider on a Bridgewell HomeCare Gold contract settles at a cash rate of 0.95; one on a Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze contract at 0.90; one on a real estate contract at 0.90.
